about: Each servo's calibrated range on the real rig, in sim joint degrees (rig.json joint_offsets_deg included). Read by the safety guard on 2026-11-11 with the pre-round-6 offsets (rig.before_bb1b28_offsets_20261113_233216.json), then shifted 2026-11-14 by the round-6 joint offsets (robots/so101/calibration/actuators/kinematics_refit.json, tag bb1b28) to match the live rig.json. If rig.json offsets change again, re-read them with a dry check.
